stories.title: Josh and the Big Fish
lines: Josh sat on the dock.
He had a net and a bug.
"Fish, fish!" said Josh.
Then a big fish hit his net.
What a shock! It was quick.
Josh got it in the net.
Dad said, "You did it!"
Josh put the fish back.

stories.title: The Pink Shell
lines: Beth and Nell ran to the shed.
In a box, Beth got a shell.
It was pink and thin.
"Can I check it?" said Nell.
She sat with it.
Beth did hum a long song.
"You sing well," Nell said.
Then Mom fed them jam.

stories.title: The Duck in the Tub
lines: Chad had a wet duck.
He put it in the tub.
The duck did not sit.
It hit the tap and ran.
Chad got a mop.
"What a mess!" he said.
The duck sat on his back.
Chad did not get mad.

stories.title: Rick and the Quiz
lines: Miss Bess had a quiz.
Rick did not wish to go.
"I am sick," he said.
Mom said, "You can do it."
Rick sat and did the quiz.
He got ten of them.
Miss Bess said, "Big win!"
Rick ran to tell Mom.

stories.title: The Chick and the Fox
lines: A wet chick sat in a shed.
A red fox got in!
The chick ran to the back.
It hid in a sock bin.
The fox did not check it.
Then Josh ran up and did yell.
The fox ran off quick.
Josh fed the chick a fig.

stories.title: Jack and the Long Song
lines: Jack got a bell and a pan.
He did bang on them.
Bang, bang, bang!
Mom said, "That is a lot."
Jack sang a long song.
Dad hung up his hat and sat.
"You sing well," said Dad.
Then Jack sang it to Nan.

stories.title: The Sock on the Rock
lines: Seth had a red sock.
It fell off in the mud.
Tim got it on a rock.
The sock was wet and tan.
"Yuck!" said Seth.
Mom put it in a tub.
She did rub and rub.
Then the sock was red.

stories.title: Kim and the Big Well
lines: Kim sat on a big well.
"I wish!" said Kim.
She got up and ran back.
Dad had a box in his lap.
In it was a tan pup!
"He is my pup?" said Kim.
Dad said, "Yes, he is."
Kim got such a big hug.

stories.title: Nick and the Chess Set
lines: Nick did not get chess.
Gus said, "Sit. I can tell you."
He set up the chess set.
Nick got it quick.
Then Nick did win!
"What luck," said Gus.
"That was not luck," said Nick.
Gus said, "You got me."

stories.title: Bess and the Moth
lines: A moth got in the shed.
Bess did not wish to check it.
It sat on a thick web.
"Do not hit it," said Mom.
Bess got a cup and a lid.
She got the moth in the cup.
Then she let it go.
Off it did go!

stories.title: Tom and the Junk Box
lines: Tom dug in a junk box.
He got a bell and a wig.
Then he got a red top.
"What a lot!" said Tom.
Dad said, "That was my box."
Tom said, "Can I get them?"
Dad did nod.
Tom ran off with the box.

stories.title: The Fish in the Dish
lines: Jill got a fish in a dish.
It was pink and quick.
She fed it a chip of ham.
The fish did not wish to sit.
It did zip up and back.
Jill said, "That fish is quick!"
Mom got a big tank.
Jill put the fish in it.

stories.title: Ted on the Bank
lines: Ted sat on the bank.
A duck ran up to him.
It did quack at his sock.
"What do you wish?" said Ted.
He had a bun in his bag.
Ted fed the duck a bit.
Then the duck sat with him.
"You can be my pal," he said.

stories.title: Pam and Jan at the Shop
lines: Pam and Jan ran to the shop.
Mom said, "Get me a fish."
Jan got a red pot.
"Mom did not wish to get that."
Pam got it in the back bin.
Cash! Then off to the van.
Mom put it in a hot pan.
Such a big fish! Yum!

stories.title: Seth and the Math Quiz
lines: Seth did not get math.
Six and six? Seth did not win.
Beth sat with him on the rug.
She had a red pen and pad.
Seth did tick them off.
Then he got it.
"You can do math," said Beth.
Seth did a quick jig.

stories.title: Max and the Red Ring
lines: Nan had a red ring.
It fell on the wet deck.
Max the cat got it quick.
He ran off to the shed.
"My ring!" said Nan.
Then Max hid it in his bed.
Nan did check and got it back.
"You bad cat!" she said.

stories.title: The Jazz Song
lines: Gus can hum a jazz song.
He got a big tin can.
Tap, tap, bang!
Jen got a bell to ring.
Ted did hit a pot.
What a mess of a song!
Mom said, "Do that in the shed."
So Gus ran off to the shed.

stories.title: The Bug on the Path
lines: Beth was on a long path.
A fat bug sat in the sun.
"Do not hit it," said Josh.
Beth let it sit on a log.
The bug did not run off.
It did a jig on the log.
Josh said, "That bug can sing!"
Then the bug ran up a hill.

stories.title: Chad and the Sick Pup
lines: Chad had a sick pup.
The pup did not run.
Chad was sad.
Dad got the pup in the van.
A vet did check his leg.
"He will be well," said the vet.
Chad got him a big hug.
Then the pup did run and hop!

stories.title: Jill and the Doll
lines: Jill had a doll in a bag.
The doll had a pink hat.
Jen said, "Let me get it."
Jill did not wish to let go.
Then the doll fell in the mud.
Jill and Jen got sad.
Mom got a rag and did rub.
Then the doll was pink!

stories.title: The Big Bath
lines: Nick was a mess of mud.
Mom set up a hot bath.
"I do not wish to get in!"
He ran to the back shed.
Dad got him with a quick dash.
In the tub, Nick did sing.
He had a duck and a cup.
Nick did not wish to get up!

stories.title: Ken and the Whiz Top
lines: Ken had a top that can whiz.
He set it on the deck.
Whiz, whiz, whiz!
It did not tip.
Then it fell off the deck.
It sank in a tub of mud.
Ken got a net and did fish.
Got it! The top was a mess.

stories.title: The Song in the Shed
lines: Meg did hum in the shed.
Tim said, "What is that song?"
"It is my song," said Meg.
She sang it to him.
Tim did sing it back.
Then Bob and Nell sang it.
Such a long, big song!
Mom said, "Can I sing with you?"

stories.title: The Duck and the Pig
lines: A duck met a pig.
"Quack!" said the duck.
The pig did not quack.
It sat in a lot of mud.
The duck did sit with it.
Then a red hen ran up.
The hen did peck at them.
So the duck hid on the pig!

stories.title: Josh in the Thick Fog
lines: Fog was thick on the hill.
Josh did not get to the shop.
He was in a big fog bank.
Then he did hit a rock.
"I can sit on this," he said.
Josh sang a long song.
Dad did yell, "Josh! Josh!"
"I am up on the rock!"

stories.title: Bob and the Big Sack
lines: Bob got a big sack.
In it was a lot of jam.
He did tug it up the hill.
The sack did rip.
Jam fell on his hat!
"What a mess," said Bob.
A dog did lick it off.
Bob said, "You can get it, pup."

stories.title: The King and the Wig
lines: A king sat on a big rock.
He had a red wig.
A duck got it and ran off!
"That is my wig!" he did yell.
Josh and his dog ran up.
The pup did dash to the duck.
Josh got the wig back.
The king said, "Thank you, lad!"

stories.title: Nell and the Bunk Bed
lines: Nell got a big bunk bed.
She did wish to be up top.
"That is my bunk!" said Bess.
Mom said, "Bess can pick."
Bess did think and think.
"Nell, you be up top," she said.
What luck! Nell ran up.
In the dim, she sang a song.

stories.title: The Chunk of Rock
lines: Rick dug up a big rock.
It was a thick chunk of red.
"What is this?" he said.
Mom did check it well.
"It is rich in tin," she said.
Rick did wish to sell it.
He got a lot of cash!
Then he got a big pet fish.

stories.title: The Moss on the Log
lines: Tim sat on a log of moss.
It was wet and thick.
A bug ran up his leg.
Tim did not wink.
Then a hen did hop up.
It did peck at the bug.
The bug hid in the moss.
Tim said, "You can not get it."

stories.title: Jen and the Pink Hat
lines: Jen got a pink hat.
It did not fit.
"It is a bit big," said Mom.
Jen did not wish to quit.
She put a peg in it.
Then the hat did fit!
Mom said, "Such a quick fix."
Jen ran off to tell Beth.

stories.title: Chad and the Hot Chip
lines: Chad had a hot chip.
He did not let it chill.
He bit it. Yuck!
His chin was red!
"Sip this," said Jill.
Chad had a big sip.
Then he was well.
"I will let it chill," he said.

stories.title: The Big Fuss
lines: Bess did kick up a fuss.
She did not wish to nap.
"Hush," said Mom.
Bess hid in the shed!
Dad got the cat and a rug.
He sang a song to Bess.
Bess did not fuss.
Then she and the cat did nap.

stories.title: The Cat in the Van
lines: Dad had a red van.
It did not run.
Sam did check the back.
A cat had a nap in it!
"Get up, cat," said Sam.
The cat did hiss at him.
Sam got it a bit of fish.
Off it ran. The van did go!

stories.title: Josh and the Rat
lines: A rat got in the shed.
It did chop at a big sack.
Josh said, "Off you go!"
But the rat did not quit.
He got a box and a lid.
Then he put a fig in it.
The rat ran to the fig!
Josh let him go on the hill.

stories.title: The Thud in the Shed
lines: Meg was in bed.
Thud! What was that?
She got up and ran to Dad.
Dad said, "It was the cat."
But the thud did not quit.
So Dad and Meg did check.
A duck sat in a tin tub!
Meg said, "What a big thud!"

stories.title: Gus and the Quick Chick
lines: Gus had a chick in a pen.
It did hop up and off.
Gus ran and ran.
The chick hid in the moss.
He did not get it.
Then Liz got a bit of ham.
The chick ran to it!
"Thank you, Liz," said Gus.

stories.title: Liz on the Mud Path
lines: Liz ran up a mud path.
Rush, rush! She was quick.
Then she hit a big rock.
She fell in the mud!
Liz was a wet mess.
Mom got a rag and a tub.
"Did you win?" said Mom.
"Yes!" said Liz. "I did."

stories.title: Jack and the Fish Tank
lines: Jack had a fish tank.
In it sat a red fish.
He fed it a bit of ham.
Then the tank did tip!
The fish fell on the rug.
"Quick!" said Mom. "Get a cup."
Jack got him in with a dish.
Back in! Such a lot of fuss.

stories.title: Beth and the Bit of Cash
lines: "Can I get a fig?" said Beth.
Mom put cash in a red bag.
Beth ran up to the shop.
But the cash was not in it!
She did check and check.
Then Seth ran up with the cash.
"It fell on the path," he said.
Beth got the fig. Yum!

stories.title: Nick and the Big Dig
lines: Nick did dig in the mud.
Thud! He hit a tin box.
"What is in this?" he said.
He got the lid off.
In it was a big shell.
Jill ran up to check it.
"Can we sell that?" she said.
"No," said Nick. "It is my luck."

stories.title: Meg and the Hen Pen
lines: Meg fed the hen at six.
The hen did not get up.
"Is it sick?" said Meg.
Dad did check the pen.
In the moss sat a red chick!
"That is the fuss," said Dad.
Meg did think it was fun.
Meg fed the chick a bit.

stories.title: Tim and the Bad Rash
lines: Tim had a rash on his leg.
Tim did not wish to rub it.
Mom put a wet rag on it.
"Do not rub," she said.
Tim sat and did a quiz.
Then he had a nap.
The rash was off at six.
"Such luck!" said Tim.

stories.title: The Bell on the Hill
lines: Up on the hill was a bell.
Ken ran up to check it.
He did ring it. Bang!
Mom and Dad ran up.
"What was that?" said Mom.
"It was me," said Ken.
Dad said, "Do not ring it."
So Ken sat and sang a song.

stories.title: Jim and the Junk Shed
lines: Jim did go in the shed.
It was a big mess of junk.
He got a sack and did dig.
He got a bat and a mug.
Then he got a tin top.
"This was my top," said Dad.
"It is my top," said Jim.
Dad said, "We can pass it on."

stories.title: Nan and the Cat on the Shed
lines: Nan can not get the cat in.
It sat up on the shed.
"Kit, kit!" she did yell.
But the cat did not hop off.
Nan got a dish of fish.
Then the cat ran up quick!
Nan fed it on the red rug.
"You win, cat," said Nan.

stories.title: Gus and the Long Path
lines: Gus had to go up a path.
It was long and it was hot.
He did huff and puff.
Then he sat on a log.
A red bug sat with him.
"Can you buzz?" said Gus.
Buzz! It did buzz at him.
So Gus got up and ran on.

stories.title: Pam and the Wet Dog
lines: Pam got a dog in the mud.
"You will get a bath," she said.
The dog did not wish to.
It ran to the back shed.
Pam got it with a big net.
In the tub, it did yell.
Then it was wet and pink.
"Such a fuss," said Pam.

stories.title: Bob and the Can of Fizz
lines: Bob got a red can of fizz.
He did not let it sit.
Pop! It did fizz on him!
Fizz got on his chin and cap.
Mom got a rag.
"You did that," said Liz.
Bob said, "I wish I did not."
Then he had a sip.

stories.title: The Ring in the Well
lines: Jill did let go of a ring.
It fell in the well.
"My ring!" she said.
Nick got a net on a rod.
He did dip it in.
Then he got it!
The ring was wet but well.
"Thank you, Nick," said Jill.

stories.title: Beth and the Big Wish
lines: Beth had a big wish.
She did wish to get a dog.
Mom said, "We can not."
Beth was sad.
But then Dad got a box.
A tan pup sat in it!
"He is my pup!" said Beth.
The pup did lick his chin.

stories.title: Jen and the Big Bash
lines: Jen had a bash at the shed.
Mom got a lot of ham.
Dad hung a red bell up.
Ted and Bob ran in.
Gus did bang on a tin pot.
Liz sang a long jazz song.
Jen said, "What a bash!"
Mom got them a dish of jam.

stories.title: The Lock on the Shed
lines: A lock was on the shed.
Sam did tug and tug at it.
It did not pop off.
Jan said, "What did Dad do?"
Sam did think a bit.
Dad hung it on a peg!
Sam ran to get it.
Then the lock did pop!

stories.title: Jill Can Win at Chess
lines: Jill sat at chess with Rick.
"I will win," said Rick.
Jill did not yell back.
She did think and think.
Rick got up to get a mug.
When he sat back, Jill did win.
"What luck," said Rick.
Jill did not tell him so.

stories.title: The Chick in the Cup
lines: A chick fell in a tin cup.
Bess did run to get it.
It was wet and mad.
"Hush," said Bess. "I will fix this."
She did tip the cup up.
Off the chick ran to a hen.
The hen did peck at Bess!
"But I got it back!" she said.

stories.title: Rick and the Thick Bun
lines: Rick got a thick bun.
It had jam in it.
Josh said, "Can I get a bit?"
Rick did not wish to.
Then Josh got a big fig.
He did not pass it on.
Rick did think a lot.
So Rick cut the bun in six.

stories.title: Nell Can Sing
lines: Nell can sing a long song.
But she did not wish to.
Mom and Dad sat on the rug.
Nell hid in the back shed.
Beth did go and sit with Nell.
"We can sing it," said Beth.
So Nell and Beth did sing.
What a big, rich song!

stories.title: Max and the Big Box
lines: A big box was on the deck.
Max did wish to check it.
But Mom said, "Do not!"
It did hum and buzz.
Then it did hop a bit!
Max ran back in the shed.
Dad got the lid off.
In it was a pink pig!

stories.title: Jan and the Fig Jam
lines: Jan did pick a big fig.
Mom got a hot pot.
In the pot it did go.
Mom did mash it up.
Such a rich red jam!
Jan had it on a bun.
"Yum!" she said. "I did that."
Dad said, "Can I get a bit?"

stories.title: Bob on the Long Dock
lines: Bob ran on the long dock.
Thud, thud, thud!
A fish did hop up.
It fell back in. Quick!
Bob sat and did not wink.
Then he got his net.
No fish! It was quick.
Bob did not get mad. He sang.

stories.title: Kim at the Doll Shop
lines: Kim and Mom got to the shop.
A doll sat in a big box.
It had a pink hat.
"Can I get that?" said Kim.
Mom did check the cash.
"We can not," she said.
Kim was sad, but did not fuss.
Mom got them a bun to pass.

stories.title: The Bug with a Bad Wing
lines: A bug had a bad wing.
Josh put it in a cup.
He fed it a bit of jam.
The bug did not buzz.
Beth said, "It will be well."
At six, it did buzz!
Up it did go, on the path.
"Go on!" said Josh. "Go!"

stories.title: Seth and the Hot Sun
lines: The sun was hot on the hill.
Seth had no cap and no cash.
He sat in the dim shed.
A cat did sit with him.
Beth ran up with a big jug.
"Get a sip," said Beth.
Seth had a big, long sip.
Then Seth and Beth ran back.

stories.title: Tom and the Chunk of Ham
lines: Mom got a big chunk of ham.
Tom did wish to get a bit.
"Not yet," said Mom.
The dog did not wish to sit.
It got up on the box!
Off it ran with the ham!
Tom did yell and dash.
Mom said, "We will get a bun."

stories.title: The Ship in the Tub
lines: Jack had a tin ship.
He did put it in the tub.
It did not sink.
Then Beth did toss a rock in.
The ship sank! Sunk!
"That was my ship," said Jack.
Beth got it up with a mug.
Jack did not get mad at Beth.

stories.title: Pam and Nan Chat
lines: Pam and Nan had a chat.
"Which cat is that?" said Nan.
"That is my cat, Rex."
Rex sat up on a rack.
He did lick his neck.
Then he did hop in a box.
"He will not get up," said Pam.
So Nan and Pam did chat on.

stories.title: Josh and the Mush
lines: Mom did fill a pot with mush.
Josh did not wish to get it.
"It is a mess," he said.
But Dad had a bit.
"Such a rich mush!" said Dad.
Josh got a lick of it.
Then he did fill a big dish!
Josh had much of it. Yum!

stories.title: Rick and the Big Pack
lines: Rick got a big pack.
He did fill it with ham.
A pot, a mug, and a cap.
Then he did tuck in a bell.
The pack was big and hot.
Rick did not get up the hill.
So he did toss the pot off.
Then he ran up quick!

stories.title: The Duck Did Honk
lines: A duck did honk at the bus.
Honk, honk! It did not quit.
Gus said, "What is that thing?"
It sat on the bus.
The bus did chug up the hill.
The duck sang a long song.
Then it did hop off.
"Much fun," said Gus. "Such a duck."

stories.title: Kim and the Pink Ink
lines: Kim got a pot of ink.
It was pink, not red.
She did dip a pen in it.
Then the pot did tip!
Ink got on Kim and the rug.
"Do not tell Mom," said Jen.
Mom did check it. No fuss!
"I did that," said Mom.

stories.title: Nell and the Red Shin
lines: Nell ran on a wet path.
She fell and hit a shin.
It was red. She did yell.
Mom ran up quick.
"Sit," said Mom. "I will check it."
She put a wet rag on it.
Then Nell got a kiss.
In a bit, she ran on.

stories.title: Chad Can Not Puff
lines: Chad ran up a long hill.
He did huff. His lung was hot.
"I can not do it," he said.
Beth said, "You can. Go!"
So Chad did chug up a bit.
Then a bit and a bit.
Up on top, he did sit.
"I did it!" he did yell.

stories.title: The Bell That Rang
lines: A bell hung in the shed.
It rang at six.
Ken did not get up.
It rang and rang.
Mom did yell, "Ken! Get up!"
He hid in bed.
Then Mom got the dog in.
It did lick him.
Up he got!

stories.title: Jill and the Big Pill
lines: Jill was sick in bed.
Mom got a pill and a jug.
"I will not," said Jill.
"It is big as a rock."
Dad cut it up a bit.
Jill had it with a sip.
"That was not much," she said.
At six, she was well.

stories.title: Tim and the Boss Hen
lines: Tim had a hen. She was boss.
The dog did not go in.
The cat ran off quick.
Tim did not fuss at the hen.
She sat up on a rack.
"Boss hen!" said Tim.
She did peck at his cuff.
Then she got a bit of ham.

stories.title: The Thing in the Sink
lines: What was that thing in the sink?
Beth did not wish to check.
It was big and it was wet.
Dad got a mug and did dip.
Then he got it up!
It was a fat, red fish.
"Tom put it in!" said Beth.
Tom did run and hid.

stories.title: Gus and the Shut Shop
lines: Gus ran to the shop at six.
But it was shut.
"No fig jam!" he said.
A man said, "Get to the hill."
So Gus ran up the big hill.
That shop was not shut!
He got the jam and a bun.
Gus did sing on the path back.

stories.title: Bob and the Big Jug
lines: Bob did tip a big jug.
Gush! It got on his sock.
"Not that rug!" said Mom.
Bob got a rag and did mop.
He did rub and rub it.
Then the rug was not wet.
"You did that well," said Mom.
Bob did a quick jig.

stories.title: Josh and the Big Shot
lines: Ted set up a tin can.
Josh had a shot at it.
He did miss.
"Get a bit up," said Ted.
Josh did think a lot.
Then he got it! Bang!
The can fell off the log.
"What a shot!" said Ted.

stories.title: Nell Got Less Jam
lines: Mom had a pot of jam.
Nell got a big bit.
Bess got less.
"That is not fun!" said Bess.
Nell did not wish to fuss.
So Nell did pass a bit on.
"Thank you," said Bess.
Mom said, "Such a big kid!"

stories.title: Jim and the Rod
lines: Jim sat on the dock.
He had a rod and a bug.
A big fish hit it!
The rod did whip up!
Jim did not let go.
Tug, tug, tug!
Then the fish was in his net.
"What a fish!" he did yell.

stories.title: Ken and the Van on the Hill
lines: Dad and Ken got in the van.
It did chug up the hill.
Then it did quit!
"Not yet!" said Dad.
He got up and did check.
It had no gas in it.
Ken ran to get a can.
Then the van did go on.

stories.title: Beth and the Long Nap
lines: Beth was sick and did nap.
She did not get up at six.
Mom did sit with Beth.
The cat did nap on the bed.
At ten, Beth did get up.
"I am well!" she said.
Mom got a dish of hot mush.
Beth had a lot of it.

stories.title: The Dog That Did Not Sit
lines: Jack got a big tan dog.
"Sit," he said. The dog ran off.
It hid in the back shed.
Jack did think a lot.
Then he got a bit of ham.
"Sit!" said Jack.
Up it sat, quick as a wink!
"You win," he said. "Get this."

stories.title: Rick and the Wet Cap
lines: Rick put his cap on a rock.
Then a duck sat on it.
The cap got wet and bad.
"That was my cap!" he said.
Mom got it in a tub.
Mom did fix it up well.
Then the cap was red, not tan.
Rick did not tell the duck.

stories.title: Josh and Beth Fix the Shed
lines: The shed had a big rip.
Josh got a bit of tin.
Beth did hang it up.
Bang, bang! Tap, tap!
Dad did check on them.
"That is a quick fix," he said.
No rip! The shed was well.
Josh and Beth had a big sip.

stories.title: Jim and the Sad Cat
lines: A cat sat in the wet moss.
It was thin and sad.
Jim got it a dish of fish.
It did not run off.
"Can we get it in?" he said.
Mom did not wish to.
But the cat sat on his lap.
So Mom said, "Yes. It can be."

stories.title: Kim and the Bug in the Jug
lines: A bug fell in a jug.
Kim did not wish to hit it.
She got a big peg.
The bug did go up it.
Up and up, to the top!
Then it did buzz off.
"Go on, bug," said Kim.
Mom said, "That was not bad."

stories.title: The Hen on the Bus
lines: Gus got on a bus.
In his bag was a red hen.
The hen did not hush.
"What is in that bag?" said Pam.
The hen did hop up!
It sat on the lap of Pam.
Pam did not get mad.
She fed it a bit of bun.

stories.title: The Song Jan Had Sung
lines: Mom sang a long song to Jan.
Jan had sung it in the van.
But she did quit at the top.
"Which bit?" said Mom.
Jan did hum a bit of it.
"That is it!" said Mom.
Then Jan sang it well.
Dad said, "Sing it to me!"

stories.title: Liz and the Red Kit
lines: Liz got a kit in a box.
In it was a red top.
She did set it on the deck.
It did whiz and it did hum.
Ted did dash up the path.
"Can I get a go?" he said.
Liz let him. The top did tip.
Liz did not get mad at Ted.

stories.title: Josh and the Six Fish
lines: Josh got six fish in a net.
Mom put them in a big dish.
Dad did cut up a red yam.
Beth did fill a pot with it.
Then it was hot and rich.
The fish was such a hit!
"Well, Josh!" said Dad.
Josh did wish to go back.

stories.title: Ted and the Bug on the Bed
lines: A bug sat on the bed.
Ted did not wish to nap.
It did buzz and buzz.
Mom got a mug to fix it.
She got the bug in it.
Off to the path it did go.
Then Ted did nap well.
In the dim, it was hush.

stories.title: Nick and the Long Log
lines: Nick and Bob got a long log.
It was thick and wet.
"We can sit on this," said Bob.
So Nick did tug it back.
Bob did puff and huff.
Up on the hill, it did fit.
Nick and Bob sat on it.
"That was much fun," said Nick.

stories.title: Pam and the Thin Pin
lines: Pam had a thin pin.
A big rip was in the rug.
She did sit and fix it.
Mom said, "You do that well."
Then the pin fell in the moss.
"Do not sit!" she did yell.
Bess got up quick.
Mom did check and got it back.

stories.title: Gus and the Bad Hat
lines: Gus had a big, bad hat.
"That hat is a mess," said Liz.
"I will not," said Gus.
Liz got him a red cap.
Gus did put it on.
Then he got the bad hat back!
Gus had a cap and a hat.
"Yes! I can do that," he said.

stories.title: Jan and the Duck at the Well
lines: Jan sat on the well at six.
A duck did hop up on it.
"Quack!" it said to Jan.
"Do you wish to chat?" she said.
The duck did not chat back.
Then it fell in the well!
Jan got a net and a rod.
Up it got, wet and mad.

stories.title: Sam and the Hot Pan
lines: Sam did wish to get a bun.
Mom set a hot pan up.
"Do not hit that," she said.
Sam did not check it.
He did tap it! Hot!
Mom got him a wet rag.
"Yes, it is hot," said Mom.
Then Sam had a big, hot bun.

stories.title: Nell and the Mash
lines: Mom did mash a pot of yam.
Nell said, "I will not get that."
Bess had a big dish of it.
"Yum!" said Bess. "Such a rich mash!"
Nell did think a bit.
She had a quick lick of it.
Then Nell got a big dish!
Mom did wink at Dad.

stories.title: Jen and the Thick Web
lines: Jen did check a thick web.
A fat bug sat on it.
"Is that bug sick?" said Tom.
"No, it is well," said Jen.
The bug did whiz off quick.
It got in a pot of jam!
Tom did tip the pot up.
Off it did go, to the web.
